---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new game mechanic, command, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A short, one-sentence description of the feature.

---

## Motivation

Why should this be added? What problem does it solve or what experience does it improve?

---

## Detailed Description

A full description of the proposed feature. Include:

- What the feature does
- How a player would interact with it (e.g., slash command, button, select menu)
- How it fits into the existing game loop (explore → fight → craft → progress)

---

## Proposed Command / UI

If applicable, describe the command name, subcommands, options, and expected embed output.

```
/example-command <option>
  → Embed: Title | Description | Fields | Buttons
```

---

## Game Balance Considerations

If this feature affects economy, stats, XP, or progression — describe how it is balanced.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you considered and why you chose this one.

---

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references to similar features in other bots/games, or any other context.
